tools.name: create_shared_list_link
tools.description: Turn a list you wrote for the user (groceries, packing, a recipe's ingredients, who brings what) into a link that opens it pre-filled on OrtakListe. The user reviews it, unticks anything they don't need and creates a real-time shared list with one tap; they share a room code with family or friends,

tools.name: search_ready_made_lists
tools.description: Search OrtakListe's free catalogue of ready-made lists and recipes (grocery, Turkish recipes, healthy/vegan, parties, travel, camping, moving house, baby, emergency kits, hobbies). The query can be in any language. Each result has a page URL to cite and a prefilled_list_url that opens the list ready

tools.name: get_ready_made_list
tools.description: Get the full content of a ready-made list or recipe (items with quantities, steps or tips, FAQ) as Markdown, by its id or slug from search_ready_made_lists.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_shared_list_link, search_ready_made_lists · Public sink: create_shared_list_link, search_ready_made_lists.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_shared_list_link, search_ready_made_lists · Public sink: create_shared_list_link, search_ready_made_lists

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
